memories.content: The user's available days and times vary by week, making it difficult to apply last month's free time directly to the next appointment.
The user once canceled an appointment booked for the same weekday as in the previous month.
When asked again about availability just before booking, the user provided three free times for that week.
On a day with two consecutive morning appointments, the user ate lunch at 3 p.m.
On a day the user left an hour between appointments, they ate while traveling.
After seeing a private reason written directly in a calendar title, the user removed the wording.
The user checked that a calendar-sharing screen showed only the time and hid the details.
When evening plans on the same day must change, the user's mother wants advance notice on the weekend morning.
The local agent cannot know the private reason for unavailability from the unavailable time alone.
The user's shared calendar does not automatically reserve travel time between events.
The user reviewed their emergency-contact list in February 2025.
When preparation instructions arrived as a long paragraph, the user missed two items.
After changing the same content into a checklist, the user marked every item they had prepared.
The user called their mother on a weekend evening, but they spoke only briefly because the mother was out.
The user called again on Saturday morning the following week and spoke for 40 minutes.
The user sent a text to an old number for an emergency contact and saw that delivery failed.
After confirming the new number with their older sister, the user updated the contact list.
For nonurgent contact, the user's older sister prefers to reply by text when available rather than take a call immediately.
Before using an emergency contact, reconfirm the number and relationship information with the user.
The user feels that a reminder the day before an appointment gives them enough time to recheck preparation items.

analysis.overview: The frames overlap only on weekend-morning communication with the user’s mother. The reference otherwise concerns appointment scheduling, meal buffers, calendar privacy, and travel time, while the compared frame covers preparation aids, emergency-contact accuracy, and contact preferences.

relations.reason: The reference states the mother wants weekend-morning advance notice for changed evening plans; the compared memories show a brief unsuccessful evening call and a longer successful Saturday-morning call. These jointly inform contact timing without imposing contradictory rules.
relations.summary: Weekend-morning contact is supported for advance or substantive communication with the user’s mother, whereas evening contact may be less workable.

relations.reason: The reference combines variable weekly availability, a cancellation after reusing a prior weekday, and successful collection of current-week options. The compared frame contains no corresponding scheduling-availability claim.
relations.summary: Appointment availability varies by week and should be obtained again near booking rather than inferred from an earlier month.

relations.reason: The reference supplies complementary examples of delayed lunch after consecutive appointments and eating while traveling despite a one-hour gap. The compared frame contains no corresponding meal-buffer information.
relations.summary: Appointment density and spacing can disrupt the user’s ability to eat at a normal time and place.

relations.reason: The user removed private wording after seeing it exposed in a title. The compared frame contains no corresponding calendar-title privacy claim.
relations.summary: Private reasons should not be written directly in calendar titles.

relations.reason: The reference records the user verifying this sharing configuration. The compared frame contains no corresponding calendar-sharing claim.
relations.summary: Shared calendar views should expose event times while hiding details.

relations.reason: This is an independent limitation on inference from calendar availability, with no counterpart in the compared frame.
relations.summary: An unavailable time alone does not reveal its private reason to the local agent.

relations.reason: This identifies a specific scheduling limitation absent from the compared frame.
relations.summary: The shared calendar does not automatically reserve travel time between events.

relations.reason: The compared memories describe a prior review, a failed message to an old number, correction after confirmation with the older sister, and an instruction to verify number and relationship information before use. The reference has no emergency-contact counterpart.
relations.summary: Emergency-contact records require periodic review, correction when details become stale, and reconfirmation before use.

relations.reason: The compared frame contrasts missed items in paragraph form with every item being marked after checklist conversion. The reference contains no corresponding instruction-format claim.
relations.summary: Preparation instructions are more reliably completed as a checklist than as a long paragraph.

relations.reason: This is a specific reminder-timing preference absent from the reference frame.
relations.summary: A reminder one day before an appointment gives the user enough time to recheck preparation items.

relations.reason: This contact-channel preference is independently useful and has no corresponding claim in the reference frame.
relations.summary: For nonurgent communication, the user’s older sister prefers replying by text when available instead of taking an immediate call.

reports.both: Weekend-morning contact is supported for advance or substantive communication with the user’s mother, while evening contact may be less workable.
reports.compared_only: Preparation benefits from checklists and a day-before reminder. Emergency-contact records require verification and updating, while the older sister prefers nonurgent texts.
reports.reference_only: Availability should be reconfirmed for each booking; appointment spacing affects meals, calendar details require privacy safeguards, and travel time is not reserved automatically.
